before: IMPACT is an onboard autonomy framework for GNSS-denied UAV exploration, integrating LiDAR–inertial localization, 3D mapping, active perception, dynamic obstacle avoidance, and fail-safe control on Atlas 200I DK A2 and openEuler. It uses navigation integrity margin to guide safe planning and recovery in uncertain environments.
after: Research software for GNSS-denied UAV navigation: joint LiDAR/visual/inertial and downward-image fusion, reproducible Ubuntu 22.04 simulations, and ArduCopter 4.7.1 interface validation.
